_comment: Indoor variant of qa_default.json. The edge-distance gate was calibrated on the outdoor gs2 scene where LiDAR range edges coincide with strong image gradients. Indoors, range jumps (doorways, wardrobe silhouettes) frequently land on textureless white walls with no image gradient nearby, starving the nearest-edge metric (house0614: per-frame p50 4-11 px with one blank-wall frame at 49 px, overall p50 10.1 px while overlays show matched red/green edges wherever texture exists). 16 px still fails gross extrinsic/pose errors, which show up as 50-100+ px everywhere. More edge frames per camera reduce single-blank-view dominance.
